children: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares soared more than 5% Tuesday after the chipmaker outlined a larger opportunity in artificial intelligence and raised expectations for its data-center business at the Citi 2026 Global TMT Conference.
AMD now estimates the AI market could reach $2 trillion by 2030. The company also expects data-center sales to approach $70 billion in 2027, roughly double the business size it anticipates for 2026.

AI accelerators are expected to account for sales in the low $40 billion range next year. Server processors are set to provide another source of expansion, with AMD projecting the market could reach $220 billion by 2030.

The company has begun shipping its MI450 products and expects production to build through the first quarter of 2027. Meta, OpenAI and Anthropic are among the customers AMD has identified for its AI products.

Demand is also creating supply challenges. AMD cited constraints involving advanced wafers, high-bandwidth memory and packaging. It has secured $29 billion to $30 billion in purchase commitments as it prepares for higher production.

title: Why AMD Stock Popped Today?
